priorExposure: Four curated real repair examples were already inspected during package development; this is not sealed confirmation evidence.
sampling: First page of 10 closed PRs ordered by creation descending, then keep merged_at <= cutoff. This is a bounded convenience window, not all merged PRs in a calendar interval or a random sample.
outcomes: canonical source touch frequencies and observed lineage
review: Read public PR body, structured files/patches, reviews/comments for each selected row; record source-specific notes. Do not infer AI authorship or confirmed bug fixes from titles, bot identity or keywords. Explicit supported labels do not become confirmed repair metrics without reproduction/strong defect evidence. Mixed/uncertain changes remain distinct.
comparability: Domains and maturity differ; related AILANG repos form one cluster. No semantic task pairing, no significance test, no valid population language delta in this pilot.
claimRestriction: Observed touch counts and evidence availability only. Numeric zero confirmed repair metrics are unascertained, not absence of bugs. No AI-specific or lifetime token conclusion without provenance/traces.
exclusions: Existing evals, language/compiler repositories and synthetic fixtures are outside this collection. No paid model runs, prompts-as-outcomes, private transcripts or generated benchmark tasks.
